on-error-propagate.doc:name: On Error Propagate
on-error-propagate.type: HTTP:NOT_FOUND, HTTP:BAD_GATEWAY, HTTP:CONNECTIVITY, HTTP:INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, HTTP:SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, HTTP:TIMEOUT, HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, HTTP:RETRY_EXHAUSTED

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var errorPayload = error --- { "errorMessage": errorPayload.errorMessage.payload default errorPayload.detailedDescription, "errorType": (errorPayload.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ":" ++ (errorPayload.errorType.identifier default ''), "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "applicationName": vars.flowName, "time": now() }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var errorPayload = error --- { "errorMessage": errorPayload.errorMessage.payload default errorPayload.detailedDescription, "errorType": (errorPayload.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ":" ++ (errorPayload.errorType.identifier default ''), "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "applicationName": vars.flowName, "time": now() }

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( !isEmpty(vars.error) ) vars.error else
{ "errorMessage": error.errorMessage.payload.message default error.detailedDescription, "errorType": (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default ''), "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "applicationName": vars.flowName, "time": now() }
